messages:
Maya (runtime): Quick check — planning to enable the feature flag for the new caching + batching path (flag: `batch_cache_v2`) in prod for a rolling canary tomorrow 10:00 PT. Scope: start at 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m gates. Need ops + oncall sign-off and a clear rollback play. Anyone available to own validation and alerts?

Kevin (perf): I can run the perf harness against staging today and post baseline vs v2 numbers. Things to watch: p95/p99 latency, request error rate, cache hit ratio, and GPU mem churn. Also verify tail latency under mixed seq lengths.

Sam (platform): Thanks. Couple guardrails I want in place before we flip:
- automatic rollback trigger if errors > 0.5% for 5m or if p99 increases > 30% over baseline
- rate-limit canary to 5% initially, health-check endpoints must be green
- a short-lived tracing tag `ff_rollout=batch_cache_v2` so we can slice traces

Priya (QA): I'll run synthetic canary workloads and the regression prompt set (eval_set_v3). I'll post diff stats (BLEU-ish + token-level divergence) and a small sample of edge-case outputs. ETA: results by 18:00 PT today.

Liam (infra): Two infra asks:
1) bump autoscale upper limit by 20% for the canary window so we don't hit OOMs if batching spikes.
2) enable extra logging for KV cache misses for 2 hours post-rollout.
I can land both config changes; will coordinate the timing.

Maya (runtime): Good — for rollbacks, who will run the flip? We should have a single owner (and a backup). Also add a deploy-blocker checklist for the canary gate.

Kevin (perf): I'll own the flip and metric checks during the 10:00 PT window. Backup: Sam. My rollback command (internal flag service):
```
# disable flag quickly
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"flag":"batch_cache_v2","env":"prod","state":"off","note":"rollback due to perf/regression"}'
```

Oncall Bot: Alert created: `prod_batch_cache_v2_errors` > 0.5% for 5m -> pager to @oncall. Also created `prod_batch_cache_v2_p99` > 30% increase -> page. Temporary retention: 48h.

Sam (platform): I added a canary route config to send 5% traffic to the variant. Also wired the `ff_rollout` tracing tag into the sampling rules.

Priya (QA): Synthetic run finished: staging shows p95 ~ +6% and p99 ~ +12%, cache hit ratio improved ~8%. No observable semantic regressions in eval_set_v3 (diff < 0.5%). Posting artifacts: link to S3 (internal).

Maya (runtime): Sounds good. Final checklist for tomorrow:
- Kevin flips to 5% at 10:00 PT and monitors dashboards (p50/p95/p99, errors, cache hit)
- 30m hold; if all good -> 25% by Kevin, 30m hold -> full rollout
- Liam has autoscale bump and logging enabled at 09:45 PT
- Priya runs smoke eval after each ramp and posts pass/fail
- Oncall Bot alerts active and paging enabled

Kevin (perf): I'll be in the #eng-oncall channel during the whole window. Ping me if you see anything weird. :thumbsup:

Sam (platform): I'll be on standby to run the rollback command if Kevin is unreachable. Leaving a note in the runbook with the exact commands and the observability panel link.

Maya (runtime): Thanks everyone — let's reconvene in this thread after the canary for a short post-mortem regardless.

Oncall Bot: Reminder scheduled 10m before the rollout window.
